formula: h=SHA256(int32be(d_n)); u_hat=int(h) mod 2**(n+4); d_hat=2**(n+4)+u_hat; exact d_hat==d_{n+5}; chain 75->80->...->130; no LE/high-bits/hex/repeat/alt-hash
score_definition: exact equality on each edge; one miss closes

allowed_parameters.bits_taken: low (n+4) bits of hash as integer

holdout_split: all locked edges; no parameter inference
trivial_exclusion_justification: Creator-side deterministic hash chain on known keys; not ECDSA or curve membership.
